arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions_within_2_minutes FROM (SELECT id, CAST(strftime('%s', date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', LAG(date) OVER (PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY date, id)) AS INTEGER) AS gap_seconds FROM transactions) WHERE gap_seconds <= 120
arguments.explanation: Counts the transactions whose time gap to the previous transaction on the same card is 2 minutes or less.
assumptions: 'Within 2 minutes' means a gap of 120 seconds or less between consecutive transactions on the same card_id.
Counts all transactions, labelled or not; the first transaction on each card has no previous one and is not counted.
Ties in date on the same card are ordered by transaction id.
Covers the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
